verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI meeting-assistant platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Otter letting users define recurring, time-based jobs or workflows. The closest items fall outside the story: the notetaker auto-joins meetings and briefings arrive before meetings, which are triggered by calendar events rather than a user-set recurring schedule. Zapier, the API and webhooks are building blocks or third-party tools, not a native scheduler, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
